--- Comment by Nadia Petrov ---
Taking this one. Initial triage: the account was opened this summer (July 7). Stated source of funds is self-employed consulting income with expected overseas customer wires, so the wire is technically in line with the narrative. The size is not. Looking at history in AMLMonitor, the account received several ACH credits in August, each just under $10,000. That pattern alone deserves a structuring look. There is nothing international before today. Pulling the KYC file from DocVault and the August ACH originator details next.

--- Comment by Nadia Petrov ---
Update, same afternoon: the funds are already moving out. Since the wire posted, there have been two internal transfers from {{ACCOUNT_NUMBER:a_00128}} to other Halcyon accounts, one for $9,500 and one for $9,800. Both are just under $10K, same as the August ACH pattern. I'm going to review the receiving accounts now: onboarding dates, source-of-funds narratives, and device and login data. I want to see whether this is a one-off or something connected. Will keep the remaining balance under watch and update here before EOD.
